ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   B. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   D. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   C. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Attributes of Allah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Angels Atid, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara Types of Najasaat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
